title: The Choir of the Ninefold Court
author: Felix Brightwater
blurb: Sable Galloway, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
